description: The Trueline is Vessa Orme's own pattern: a straight, honest, slightly overweight shortsword with nothing clever about it anywhere. She makes about one a week and will not be hurried. The circle worn flat on one side is the house mark and goes on all of them — the signature under the guard does not. That one she cuts by hand, and only into the ones that came out the way she wanted.
name: Orme Trueline signature shortsword
